tasks.title: Promote settings, categories, and shop-mapping migrations
tasks.dod: Staged 01 and 02 are promoted to live Alembic revisions; upgrade and downgrade apply and revert cleanly.

tasks.title: Promote drafts and draft-lines migration
tasks.dod: Staged 03 is promoted; upgrade and downgrade apply and revert cleanly; at most one drafts row is a schema-plus-app concern documented on the revision.

tasks.title: Promote monthly-close and egress-line migrations
tasks.dod: Staged 04 and 05 are promoted; upgrade and downgrade apply and revert cleanly including unique utc_month on monthly_closes.

tasks.title: Encode spend-looking detection and pair splitting
tasks.dod: Unit tests accept a line with an amount-like number plus other non-numeric text, reject other talk, and split one family-group message into several spend-looking lines.

tasks.title: Encode completed-month, shop-key, and frozen-category rules
tasks.dod: Unit tests refuse the current incomplete UTC month, match shops after trim and case only, and refuse an empty confirmed category list (Uncategorized does not count).

tasks.title: Encode draft, suspect, handle, and total rules
tasks.dod: Unit tests classify suspect versus clean, accept each handle choice, omit excluded lines from totals, and keep other-currency lines out of default-currency totals.

tasks.title: Persist settings, categories, and shop mappings
tasks.dod: SQLite adapter round-trips the settings singleton, frozen categories, and shop mappings with ULID ids; a second settings row is refused.

tasks.title: Persist drafts, monthly closes, and egress lines
tasks.dod: SQLite adapter round-trips one draft with lines, replaces a monthly close by utc_month, and copies egress rows onto the saved close.

tasks.title: Add HarvestPort and the user-session harvest adapter
tasks.dod: Harvest adapter returns a completed month's family-group messages with no export file and no silent drop; an unreadable month becomes AppError harvest.month_not_obtained.

tasks.title: Add ModelPort that accepts only spend-looking lines
tasks.dod: Model adapter refuses non-spend-looking text before any send and returns categories or Uncategorized only for lines that passed the on-machine gate.

tasks.title: Implement complete-first-run use case
tasks.dod: Unit tests with a fake PersistencePort confirm currency and a non-empty list, pin the closer, and return first_run.empty_category_list or first_run.still_required on the error paths.

tasks.title: Implement harvest-month and private-draft pipeline
tasks.dod: Unit tests with fake HarvestPort and ModelPort cover incomplete, unreadable, busy, empty, and large months, spend-looking-only egress, and a private draft the family group never receives.

tasks.title: Implement handle-suspect and shop-map growth
tasks.dod: Unit tests persist each handle choice, upsert the shop map on assign_category, and leave a different remaining spelling unmapped.

tasks.title: Implement save-monthly-close
tasks.dod: Unit tests save only when every suspect is handled, refuse save.no_draft and save.unhandled_suspect, and replace an existing close for the same utc_month.

tasks.title: Implement resume-on-start
tasks.dod: Unit tests load settings, map, saved close, and an in-progress draft including handles already made after a stop, with no first-run re-entry.

tasks.title: Map first-run and AuthZ onto the closer bot
tasks.dod: Bot adapter runs the first-run wizard and returns auth.not_closer with no draft or close detail; inbound family-group talk is silence.

tasks.title: Map harvest, draft, handle, and save onto the closer bot
tasks.dod: Bot adapter maps /close, the suspect conversation, and /save to the contract outcomes and screens SCR-02 through SCR-06.

tasks.title: Wire the process and prove the quality goals
tasks.dod: __main__ constructs adapters and injects them at ports; QG-1 egress fixture, QG-2 timed 500-message fake, and QG-3 stop/start against real SQLite pass; smoke boot still passes.

tasks.title: Show SCR-04 Handle picks the closer can use
tasks.dod: Private-draft reply lists each remaining suspect as a Handle pick; a bot test goes draft reply → pick → handle using only that reply, then /save.

tasks.title: Offer frozen categories on SCR-05 assign and grow the shop map
tasks.dod: assign_category on SCR-05 lists confirmed category names; a bot test assigns one, grows the map, and a later /close files that shop (trim+case) while a different spelling stays unmapped.
